description: This Java source file defines the ContactablesLoaderCallbacks class, which implements loader callback methods for querying contact data using Android's LoaderManager and CursorLoader. It handles creating loaders, processing loaded data, and resetting loaders, specifically for searching contact names, emails, and phone numbers in an Android app.

classes.name: ContactablesLoaderCallbacks
classes.description: A helper class implementing LoaderManager.LoaderCallbacks<Cursor> to handle contact data queries via loaders in an Android application.

methods.name: ContactablesLoaderCallbacks
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the callback with a given Context.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns a CursorLoader to query contact data based on the provided query string.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Processes the Cursor once the data is loaded, updating a TextView to display contact details.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the loader is reset; currently empty.
